description: Deep Rest Music | Sarod Instrumental | 3 Hours of slow Indian classical sarod for evenings when you have nothing left.
You don't have to fix anything tonight. Three hours of deep, warm sarod in Raga Darbari — slow, heavy, and kind — to let your body finally stand down.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume, lights low. Long enough to carry a whole evening of rest, reading, or drifting.
⏱ BEST FOR — burnout recovery · deep rest · evening wind-down · after a hard week · rest without guilt
🎵 ABOUT — the sarod's deep fretless voice is Indian classical music's most grounded sound; Raga Darbari is the midnight raga of gravity and stillness.
